description.title: Zoho CRM (application) - Wikipedia
description.snippet: Zoho CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) application developed by Zoho Corporation, an India-based technology company. It is delivered as a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product and includes features for managing sales processes, marketing activities, and customer support. [1][2]

authentication.title: OAuth 2.0 Authentication | Zoho CRM API | V8
authentication.snippet: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication. OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard protocol specification that enables third-party applications (clients) to gain delegated access to protected resources in Zoho via an API.

authentication.title: Authorization Request | Zoho CRM API | V8
authentication.snippet: To use the Zoho CRM APIs, the users must authenticate the application to make API calls on their behalf with an access token. The access token, in return, must be obtained from a grant token (authorization code).
